review_method: Direct pixel inspection of both private rendered images by the coordinating agent and a second reviewing agent; image files remain local.

observations: The native SR-16, first-person arms, gloves and sleeves render in a lit firing lane with visible targets.
The expanded Vietnamese F1 guide is readable and its text fits within the panel and viewport.
The status panel shows SR-16, current mode Auto and available modes Single / Auto.
A small white reticle is visible at the image center (840, 525), matching the lab's 8-pixel reticle presentation.
No gameplay debug warning text or shader-preparation overlay is visible. The normal development-build watermark remains visible.
The native LOADOUT screen renders its character preview, weapon and gear sections, menu labels and Back button.
The Gun Lab guide/status panel and crosshair are hidden while the native loadout screen is displayed.
The visible Back button and preset-save text establish presentation only; this capture does not demonstrate activating them or changing a selection.

profile_preservation.scope: The optional UI audit runner restored the pre-run MetaGameProfile.sav bytes. This does not test menu Back/save interactions or certify earlier unbacked runs.

scope: Two rendered images establish visible presentation only. The input/state verifier is separate evidence; these images do not certify temporal animation, heard audio, all weapons and attachments, native menu interactions or retail gunfeel parity.
